result.title: ProTok: Unified Protein Tokenization via Modular Multi-Codebook Quantization
result.summary: Protein sequence, structure, and functional annotations each capture complementary aspects of protein biology, yet existing tokenizers encode each modality independently, limiting the expressiveness of discrete protein representations. We present ProTok, a unified protein tokenizer that maps all three modalities into a modular discrete vocabulary via product quantization with per-modality codebook groups and modality dropout. A single ProTok checkpoint supports flexible inference from any modality subset without retraining. On seven StructTokenBench benchmarks spanning 14 tasks and 28 test splits, ProTok achieves an average rank of 1.4 across all structure-only tokenizers, placing first on 21 splits and among the top two on 27 of the 28. These gains come without sacrificing reconstruction: ProTok's tokens reach 0.939 lDDT on CATH 4.2, showing that multi-codebook quantization and multi-modal training yield tokens that are both reconstructable and informative. ProTok's structure tokens further lead all baseline structure tokenizers on zero-shot functional retrieval across CATH, Enzyme Commission, and Gene Ontology label hierarchies. The vocabulary also supports generation: a compact language model trained from scratch over ProTok tokens jointly generates backbone and sequence, with 52% of sampled backbones designable versus 21% for a parameter-matched GeoBPE baseline. ProTok shows that structure, sequence, and function can share one discrete vocabulary, motivating protein language models that reason over a unified token stream.

AI.brief_summary: ProTok 提出统一的蛋白质 tokenizer，用带分模态码本组的产品量化与 modality dropout，把序列、结构、功能注释三类模态编码进同一套离散词表；单一 checkpoint 可在任意模态子集下推理，并在结构相关基准与零样本功能检索上超过单模态基线，其 token 还能支撑从零训练的小模型联合生成骨架与序列。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「分模态码本组 + 产品量化 + modality dropout」为多模态内部状态如何在不同模态子集（如缺失视觉）下仍保留可解码信息提供了可核查的方法线索，或可类比 LVR 中视觉旁路与信息坍缩的表示设计问题。
